ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $OA \perp OB$, $\angle COD = 60^\circ$. If $\angle BOC = \frac{3}{7}\angle AOD$, what is the degree measure of $\angle AOD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:}
Given: $\because$ $\angle AOB=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle BOD=\angle AOD-\angle AOB=\angle AOD-90^\circ$,\\
$\because$ $\angle COD=60^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle BOD=\angle COD-\angle BOC=60^\circ-\angle BOC$,\\
$\therefore$ $60^\circ-\angle BOC=\angle AOD-90^\circ$,\\
$\because$ $\angle BOC=\frac{3}{7}\angle AOD$,\\
$\therefore$ $60^\circ-\frac{3}{7}\angle AOD=\angle AOD-90^\circ$,\\
Solving, we get: $\angle AOD=\boxed{105^\circ}$.
